name: current-peer-declares-protocol-version
description: a client talking to a current peer declares the protocol version it speaks
kill: stop declaring protocolVersion on the run input

dotnet.intentional: The .NET client does not implement the in-band version declaration: it sends no protocolVersion and makes no comparison. `request` has to be overridden at all because the base subset names the very member this lane must not send; it is narrowed to the members the client does send rather than left as an empty object that would have matched any request. `requestAbsentPaths` is what pins the absence, and it counts an explicit null as present.
